categories.name: Ethiopian Dishes
categories.description:
Authentic Ethiopian flavors featuring traditional spiced stews,
flatbreads, and bold aromatic ingredients.

items.title: Doro Wat
items.text: Spiced chicken stew with onions, ginger, garlic, and Ethiopian spices served with injera bread.

items.title: Misir Wat
items.text: Red lentil stew with onions, tomatoes, and aromatic spices, slow-cooked to perfection.

items.title: Gomen
items.text: Collard greens sautéed with garlic, ginger, and traditional Ethiopian spices.

items.title: Kitfo
items.text: Minced raw beef mixed with mitmita spice blend, butter, and finely chopped red onions.

items.title: Tibs
items.text: Sautéed diced meat with peppers, onions, tomatoes, and Ethiopian spices, cooked over a slow flame.

items.title: Shiro
items.text: Creamy chickpea flour paste with onions, ginger, garlic, and Ethiopian spices.

items.title: Injera Platter
items.text: Traditional spongy flatbread made from teff flour, served as base or with honey butter.

items.title: Beacon
items.text: Ethiopian-style sautéed meat with peppers, onions, and smoked spices.
